item.title: The untold stories of India’s medal winners
item.description: This year, India finished 4th in the medal rankings at the Commonwealth Games, winning 39 medals. That’s a big deal. But what’s even more inspiring are the life stories of the athletes who won those medals. Arshi Yasin from The Bridge sent me some of their stories, and they are incredible. Reading about the backgrounds these athletes come from, the adversity they had to face to get to where they are, is incredible.
